_provenance.dataset: public Arabic MoCA dataset (Rabaya et al. 2026, Front. Psychol. 17:1833118), 24 speakers of letter-fluency audio; DERIVED DISTRIBUTION 7 cognitively normal / 6 MCI / 11 dementia
_provenance.model: the ENGLISH-trained language-independent ACOUSTIC model applied to Arabic audio -- both the language AND the task differ from training
_provenance.verification: reproduced 2026-08-22 from a fresh clone under a pre-registered protocol: the 24 re-extracted predictions matched predictions.npy with max |delta p| = 0.0; grade MATCH (results/reconstruction/arabic_pilot_reproduction.json), whose distribution block records Dementia 11 / MCI 6 / Normal 7
_provenance.caveat: 0.622 [0.378, 0.857] -- the interval SPANS CHANCE. Feasibility only, never a validation. The Arabic linguistic engine and the referential deficit index were NOT evaluated here
_provenance.CORRECTION_2026-08-23: This file previously described the split in prose as '11 normal / 6 MCI / 7 dementia' while its own groups block, the reproduction record and arabic_reference_preliminary.json all said the opposite. CLOSED 2026-08-23: the owner confirmed against the development transcript, which records 7 normal / 6 MCI / 11 dementia and states that the derivation matched the published paper exactly. The distribution is 7 NORMAL, 6 MCI, 11 DEMENTIA. CONSEQUENCE: the pilot compares SEVENTEEN impaired speakers against SEVEN controls and must be described that way everywhere. AUC 0.622 [0.378, 0.857] rests on seven controls.

source: Arabic MoCA AI Dataset, Rabaya et al., Frontiers in Psychology 2026
labels_derived: MoCA totals summed from task scores using official v8.1 structure (registration trials excluded); maximum exactly 30. Derived distribution: 7 normal, 6 MCI, 11 dementia, matching the published paper. NOTE: the repository README states 10/8/6, which disagrees with both this derivation and the paper.
task_used: language_fluency (letter fluency), the only task comparable to the present battery
model_applied: English-trained language-independent acoustic model (AUC 0.708 on English)
honest_interpretation: First measured Arabic result for this system, but NOT a validation. The confidence interval spans chance. The transfer is doubly hard: a model trained on English picture-description was applied to Arabic letter-fluency recordings, so both language and task differ. The healthy comparison group is SEVEN people. Reported as a feasibility signal, not evidence of Arabic accuracy.

training_attempts.conclusion: Configuration choice swung the result between 0.420 and 0.655 -- a range wider than any plausible real effect. Twenty-four participants cannot train or meaningfully fine-tune a model. Combining with English data made performance worse, most likely because the Arabic task (letter fluency) differs from the English task (picture description), so the added samples conflict rather than reinforce.

normative_comparison.caveat: Task differs between groups, so language and task effects cannot be separated. With 7 controls this is indicative only.
